verdict.rationale: Replicate is an API-first service ('Run AI with an API', 'one line of code', run a model from Node.js), so the product itself can be driven headlessly from code. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI usage, such as pipeline setup, token handling or GitHub Actions, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, API authentication docs for non-interactive environments, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can run these with one line of code.
